svg.aria-label: Inside fip.bin: a table of contents followed by eight images: BL31, the OP-TEE header, the OP-TEE image, U-Boot, the fw-config device tree, U-Boot's device tree, BL31's device tree and the DDR training firmware, with their offsets, sizes, fiptool flags, make arguments and the address BL2 loads each one to.
svg.text: Inside fip.bin: eight images behind one table of contents
A Firmware Image Package is a ToC (a UUID per image, with offset and size) followed by the images. BL2 asks for each by UUID.
fip.bin = 1,999,368 bytes, drawn to scale (a few images are thinner than one pixel and are drawn 3 px wide)
28-byte header that tells BL31 how to start OP-TEE
the trusted OS image (tee-pager_v2.bin), SCMI server inside
BL2's load plan: where each image goes
BL31's own device tree (SoC settings for the monitor)
lpddr4_pmu_train.bin: the memory controller's training code
EL3 Runtime Firmware BL31: offset=0x1A0, size=0xB530, cmdline="--soc-fw"
Secure Payload BL32 (Trusted OS): offset=0xB6D0, size=0x1C, cmdline="--tos-fw"
Non-Trusted Firmware BL33: offset=0xB806C, size=0x1146A8, cmdline="--nt-fw"
• tee-pageable_v2.bin is 0 bytes here (OP-TEE paging is off), so it is not packed.
• BL2 itself is NOT in the FIP: the Boot ROM loaded it from fsbla1 beforehand.
• The FIP partition is 4 MiB; this FIP uses about 2.0 MB, U-Boot being the biggest part.
Sizes and offsets are from the build described in docs/10-versions.md. UUIDs and flags: TF-A include/tools_share/firmware_image_package.h and plat/st/common/common.mk.
